title: Get comment counts.
description: Count comments, optionally narrowed to one resource by scope (e.g. Dashboard, Insight, FeatureFlag) and item_id. Use when you only need the number — for example to check whether a resource has any discussion before digging in. To read the comments themselves use comments-list; for a full reply chain use comment-thread.
